scenes.hook: C S S Classes vs identifiers. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Classes and identifiers let C S S select particular elements. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: A dot selects a class; a hash selects an identifier.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw.
scenes.tip: Reuse a class to apply the same style to several elements. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Keep identifiers unique, and avoid unnecessary selector specificity.
scenes.try: Style two elements with one shared class. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
